sources.officialityEvidence: The official portal identifies the Government of Montserrat Consular Services as the eVisa processor.
sources.supportingExcerpt: If you are a national of country listed under the visa required list, then you require a visa.

unresolved.reason: The live Cayman CBC table maps Sudan as the Republic of the Sudan but does not name South Sudan in either column. Its listed exemptions are residence, work-permit, age, or third-country-document conditions. No South Sudan passport-wide complement or correction is inferred.

Kosovo is absent from both live Montserrat nationality lists. The eVisa FAQ says nationals on the visa-required list require a visa, while its general application eligibility does not establish a Kosovo passport-wide requirement. No complement is inferred.
